decisions.clean_break: Unpublished project: public allowlist, no permanent compatibility promise; retire old readers and maintained scripts together.
decisions.internal_state: A variable does not need an external control. GGUF facts, adapter correctness and planner outputs are internally owned.
decisions.logging: INFO default, scoped file DEBUG/VERBOSE. No verbosity-triggered full tensor dumps or behavior-changing debug switches.
decisions.startup: Discover -> measure -> choose. First-launch calibration target <=5 seconds, deeper developer tuning optional.
decisions.runtime: Bounded policy updates, not environment mutation; hysteresis/cooldown/backoff; no initial topology/binding changes.
decisions.performance: 95% of validated manual baseline is a per-workload phase-separated target, not an established result.

known_limits: Source occurrence is not proof of use in a production run; all per-control recommendations are review candidates.
No knob is declared dead solely from its name, apparent age, hash suffix or absence from a recipe. ZEROMOE_LLAMA_CPP_TAG is separately checked as warning-only build compatibility input.
Actual runtime predicates/defaults can differ across readers and worktrees; excerpts, digests, and member references preserve evidence.
No git-history introduction/last-use dates are inferred; 'when used' means execution lifecycle.
Third-party sources, generated/build outputs, obsolete/experimental directories and dated glm_runs/qwen_runs/qwen_probe archives are excluded.
Tool argument strings include forwarding and help examples; script env references include assignments and local variables. These are not confirmed external engine controls.
Dynamic environment name construction is listed separately and requires follow-up; OpenAI/Anthropic JSON request schema fields are not counted as CLI/TOML knobs.
Not all platform/compiler/framework options or preprocessor constants are project-owned knobs. Only project/ggml capability guards and declared build/cache controls are listed.
TOML declarations preserve comments and initializer expressions where found; these are not asserted effective defaults when config/environment/family overrides apply.
member_name_occurrences are lexical .member/->member matches, not type-resolved consumers; generic names such as name/role can refer to unrelated objects. Trace actual ownership before edits.
The MTP/API snapshots are independent unmerged worktrees, not features presumed present in the settings worktree.
No CUDA/model parity or performance runs were performed for this audit.
